Refine sac thai cua chinh em: day la loi UX (mat return-to destination), login VAN thanh cong → khong phai P0 sap SLO-2 Auth nhu R1 em ham y. Van la bug song phai fix, fix 1 dong (doi regex /[ -\s]/ → /[\x00-\x20]/ hoac /\s/) + test hyphen PASS, //evil.com/javascript: BLOCK. rebuttals.topic: Alert #14/15/16 xss-through-dom (AdminViBlogEditor, EditLivestreamDialog) — fix validate URL scheme hay dismiss?
rebuttals.myRound1Position: #14/15/16 dismiss-able: admin-only self-XSS tren input cua chinh admin, khong phai UGC khong tin cay.
rebuttals.note: Da mo 2 file architect chi. Sink deu la — AdminViBlogEditor.tsx:295 va EditLivestreamDialog.tsx:114-115 . Nguon gia tri: admin go tay (onChange setCoverImageUrl:283 / setThumbnailUrl:109) hoac tu DB (cover_image_url:83, thumbnail_url:62). KHONG execute 'javascript:' trong browser hien dai → khong co XSS ke ca self-XSS. Rieng o AdminViBlogEditor.tsx:400 la `/vi/blog/${slug}` (prefix co dinh) → khong inject scheme duoc. Vi vay fix cua architect khong dong lo hong nao co that. Nguoc lai, 'http/https-only allow-list' se CHAN 'data:image/...;base64' URI — von la nguon anh HOP LE cho — gay regress im lang tren preview. Ket luan giu nguyen: dismiss-with-reason dung hon; neu Cuong van muon code thi chi nen la kiem tra URL hop-le giu 'data:' va '/', KHONG phai scheme allow-list http/https. Viec mo file cang cung co lap truong dismiss chu khong lat.
